facts.statement: The Q3 call reports extending AI use cases across the Group. Enterprise process/role redesign and available external scope are not established.
facts.interpretation_limit: A reported fact is not seller access, procurement, funding, urgency or unmet customer need.

facts.statement: easyJet reported launching a customer search integration for flights and holidays.

facts.statement: Computacenter reports its CRM rollout as completed.
facts.interpretation_limit: Do not pitch a greenfield CRM rollout or assume the completed programme is open to this seller.

facts.statement: Computacenter reports design work for upgrading its existing ERP to a cloud-based version.

facts.statement: Computacenter reports continuing investment in its cybersecurity framework.
